high_level_description: This image is the cover of Vogue Korea magazine from March 2018. The cover features a model posing dynamically with a confident and stylish demeanor. She is wearing a black leather jacket over a silver top, paired with black sneakers that have white accents. Her hair is styled in loose waves, adding to her chic look. The background is a plain, light beige color, which helps to highlight the model and the vibrant colors of the text and design elements on the cover.
